CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS quote_pool_identity_cache (
    chain_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    dex TEXT NOT NULL,
    identity TEXT NOT NULL,
    token0 TEXT NOT NULL,
    token1 TEXT NOT NULL,
    fee INTEGER NOT NULL,
    identifier JSONB NOT NULL,
    legacy_payload JSONB,
    last_checked_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(chain_id,dex,identity)
)

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS quote_pool_identity_cache_pair_idx
    ON quote_pool_identity_cache(chain_id,dex,token0,token1)

INSERT INTO quote_pool_identity_cache(chain_id,dex,identity,token0,token1,fee,identifier,legacy_payload,last_checked_at)
    SELECT chain_id,dex,'legacy-v3:' || token0 || ':' || token1 || ':' || fee::text,token0,token1,fee,
        jsonb_build_object('protocol','v3','tokenA',token0,'tokenB',token1,'fee',fee),
        to_jsonb(quote_pool_cache),last_checked_at
    FROM quote_pool_cache
    ON CONFLICT(chain_id,dex,identity) DO NOTHING
